novel_features.name: Explicit flight date grid
novel_features.description: Compare retrieved trip totals across a bounded list of explicit departure and return dates.
novel_features.rationale: Coordinates complete source-confirmed searches while retaining a status for each requested cell.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the traveller can choose among specific dates and needs fresh, comparable offers.

novel_features.name: Explicit hotel stay grid
novel_features.description: Compare source stay totals for one property across equal-length stays with fixed occupancy.
novel_features.rationale: Combines actual room retrievals and preserves the different room and rate identities returned for each stay.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to compare specific alternative stays without assuming identical rooms are available.

novel_features.name: Flight trade-off frontier
novel_features.description: Keep retrieved flight offers that trade price against stops and elapsed time.
novel_features.rationale: Joins authoritative trip totals to complete itineraries from a matched-context local snapshot.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to reduce an existing search to source-backed trade-offs without a subjective score. Offers with missing price, stops or duration remain in unknown_dimensions.

novel_features.name: Same-room cancellation price difference
novel_features.description: See the stay-price difference between comparable cancellable and nonrefundable room rates.
novel_features.rationale: Pairs only explicit source cancellation classifications for the same room, occupancy, meal and payment context.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when choosing a rate plan for the same room and stay. Unknown or unmatched policies remain unpaired; zero comparable cancellation pairs is a valid result.

novel_features.name: Quote snapshot changes
novel_features.description: Compare matched-offer price and policy changes between two explicit retrieval snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Correlates exact source identities under identical context and reports missing results as not returned.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to explain changes between two actual searches without inferring sold-out inventory.

narrative.headline: Research dated flights and hotel stays with source price bases, complete itineraries and comparable quote snapshots.
narrative.value_prop: Retrieve Traveloka flight and hotel offers with explicit dates, party, market and currency. Compare selected dates and source-backed snapshots while retaining itinerary details, room policies, price units and canonical booking links.
narrative.auth_narrative: Consumer searches require a legitimate anonymous Traveloka browser session. Run auth capture --launch --timeout 2m with an already installed browser-use backend, or auth import-session with Traveloka-only cookie and captured-request JSON files. auth capture without --launch prints its plan. Capture closes its task guest browser before POST airport validation; ordinary searches replay directly over HTTP. Select the private mode-0600 session file with TRAVELOKA_SESSION_FILE or --session-file. Protection/expiry requires explicit normal-browser refresh. Airport validation proves that endpoint at that time; actual flight/hotel access is checked by the intended query. No partner API key, account change, CAPTCHA solving or global installation is performed.

quickstart.comment: Check the CLI safely before session setup.

quickstart.command: traveloka-pp-cli resolve --query Singapore --kind airport --market SG --locale en-SG --currency SGD --limit 5 --agent
quickstart.comment: Resolve source airport IDs under explicit shopper context.
Retrieve complete one-way offers and save a secret-free comparison snapshot.
Inspect dated room-rate policies and explicit stay versus nightly prices.

troubleshoots.symptom: AUTH_REQUIRED, ACCESS_BLOCKED or an empty HTTP 202 response
troubleshoots.fix: Run traveloka-pp-cli auth capture --launch --timeout 2m for a fresh normal Traveloka guest session; use scoped manual import if normal source intervention is essential. No challenge is bypassed.

troubleshoots.symptom: A return-leg display looks like a zero or small extra fare
troubleshoots.fix: Use flights search --return-date; it retrieves the combined source total rather than summing displayed deltas.

troubleshoots.symptom: Hotel rates do not fit the requested party
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect occupancy_match and use hotels rooms with the exact adults, rooms, children and child-ages flags.

troubleshoots.symptom: Snapshot comparison rejects different dates or currencies
troubleshoots.fix: Retrieve both snapshots using identical query context; no currency conversion or unlike-stay ranking is performed.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for explicit-date Traveloka flight and hotel research, detailed room and itinerary inspection, and canonical booking handoff. Use date grids for a small list of acceptable dates and snapshot commands for reproducible comparisons of already retrieved offers.
anti_triggers: Booking, paying, cancelling or modifying a reservation
CAPTCHA bypass, proxy rotation or synthetic clearance tokens
Tours, buses, packages or other Traveloka products
Guaranteed final ticket prices or inferred sold-out inventory
